title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19840 private issue summaries and descriptions could be read via agile board…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack before version 2026.2.19840 allows private issue summaries and descriptions to be read via agile board queries for archived projects. This could lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information. The issue has a low severity rating and a CVSS score of 3.1.
